summary: Blue Moon Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing entry into an underwriting agreement for a bought deal public offering of 10,000,000 common shares at C$10.00 per share for aggregate gross proceeds of C$100,000,000. The offering includes a 1,300,000-share over-allotment option. Underwriters include Scotia Capital Inc., Canaccord Genuity Corp., ATB Capital Markets Corp., and others. This is a standard equity capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No special-situation elements are present; the filing is a routine offering.
